items.title: Lamar Jackson: 'Real chance' at Week 6 return
items.text:
Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, has a "real chance" to return to action next week against Cleveland, pending how he responds to rehab, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Eyeing Week 6 return
items.text:
Williams (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Green Bay but isn't expected to suit up, is "pushing to play" Week 6 against the Falcons, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Tate (back), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, is "definitely trending" toward playing, a source tells Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Pregame workout to determine availability
items.text:
Addison (hamstring) will work out pregame before the Vikings make a call on his availability for Sunday's contest in New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Listed questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Jefferson (ankle) will go through a pregame workout before the Vikings make a decision on his availability for Sunday's contest at New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
